business_summary.text: RBZ Jewellers is a leading organized manufacturer of gold jewellery with a diversified business model offering products to national retailers on wholesale and job work basis, as well as direct to consumers through its retail store in Ahmedabad.

call_points.text: No FY27 guidance provided due to uncertainty from recent gold import restrictions
Retail gross margins around 12-14%, wholesale 7-8%, B2B 6-8%
Debt levels expected to peak at 1.2:1 debt-equity ratio after new store openings

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received an Assessment order dated 26th March, 2025, under section 143(3) read with section 144B of Income Tax act,1961,for the income tax return filed for the financial year 2022-23 (A.Y.2023-24), wherein certain additions/Disallowances with respect to returned income, have been proposed by the assessing officer. The demand of Rs. 25.28 crores raised under section 156 of the Income-Tax Act, 1961 which is mainly on account of treating the issuance of bonus share as unexplained u/s 68 of the Income Tax Act,1961.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has received a final order u/s 250 of the Income Tax Act dated on 5th December, 2025 in which the appeal is partly allowed and is majorly in favour of the Company. The original addition of INR 2,617.26 lakh made in the Assessment Order stands substantially reduced by 99.78% to INR 5.65 lakh by way of the CIT(Appeal) Order.Against which the company has filed an appeal before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal.

tax_litigation.status: The Company has received the order from Income Tax Appellate Tribunal dated on 13.03.2026 wherein the Authority deems appropriate to restore the matter to the file of the Assessing Officer with a direction to carry out necessary verification for the addition of Rs.5.65 Lakhs. Therefore, the appeal filed by the company is allowed for the statistical purposes.

operating_notes.text: Total merchandise value sold in FY26 was ₹1,251 Cr, with retail contributing ₹408 Cr and B2B contributing ₹843 Cr
Inventory maintained at 20-25% below current market price as a hedge against gold price volatility
Retail store consumption split: 35% daily wear, 65% occasion wear

timeline.summary: RBZ Jewellers reported Q4FY26 results with 38% YoY revenue growth to ₹190 Cr and announced plans to open 4 new stores in Gujarat by Q2FY27
